Create a grand holiday centerpiece!This pre-lit Christmas tree combines snow-covered greenery, brilliant illumination, and a towering silhouette for an impressive seasonal centerpiece. Standing 366 cm tall, the spruce-inspired profile features 2212 branch tips arranged in graceful layers beneath a delicate frosted coating, bringing wintry dimension to spacious interiors. Across the foliage, 950 multicolored LED lights cast vibrant radiance, giving this artificial Xmas tree a cheerful atmosphere for seasonal celebrations. Its slender pencil form makes efficient use of floor area while maintaining an eye-catching vertical presence. Premium PVC greenery provides reassuring material qualities for indoor enjoyment around children and pets. For convenient preparation, hinged branches unfold smoothly, while the 5-section structure simplifies assembly, disassembly, and packing between seasons. A foldable crossed metal stand keeps this flocked Christmas tree securely positioned and allows compact storage after use. Ideal for high-ceiling living rooms, grand foyers, hotel lobbies, and other spacious settings, it brings striking seasonal character to large decorative arrangements.Note: The decorations are not included

7906816232952.sourceDescription:
Product Features
8 Dynamic Lighting Modes: The pre-lit Christmas tree features 8 lighting modes, including slow fade, wave and steady-on effects, creating a charming festive atmosphere. The included adaptor allows you to switch between lighting modes.
Easy Hinged Assembly: Featuring a 3-section hinged design, the tree is easy to assemble, with branches that automatically drop into position. A pair of gloves is included to help protect your hands during setup.
Realistic PE and PVC Foliage: Crafted with detailed branch tips and lush mixed PE and PVC foliage, this tree replicates the natural appearance of a real Christmas tree. The selected materials are designed to resist deformation and provide a durable finish.
Stable Metal Stand: The folding metal stand provides reliable support, while anti-slip foot pads help protect your floor from scratches. Suitable for homes, offices and shops.
Warm White LED Lights: Adorned with warm white LED lights, the tree creates an inviting festive glow. The energy-efficient LEDs offer lower power consumption and a long-lasting lighting solution.
 
Specifications
Colour: Green
Material: PVC, PE, Metal
Tree Height: 136 cm
Stand Diameter: 40 cm
Tree Width: 100 cm
Number of Branch Tips: 386
Number of LED Lights: 180
Number of Sections: 2
Net Weight: 5 kg
 
Please Note
All dimensions are measured manually, so slight variations of 2–3 cm may occur.
Actual colours may vary slightly depending on monitor settings and screen displays.
Decorative items shown in the pictures are not included in the delivery.
Attractive 8-Mode Lighting: The pre-lit Xmas tree will refresh your cherished holiday, since it comes with 8 different dynamic modes, including slow fade, in waves, steady on, etc. More, with your safety in mind, it's fitted with a secured adaptor, which will help you control the lighting mode.
Hinged Design and Easy Setup: Thanks to the 3-section hinged frame, the Christmas tree can be installed effortlessly in minutes, as branch tips will automatically expand. Besides, the package includes a pair of gloves to protect your hands from injuries.
Realistic and Safe Decoration: Crafted with attention to detail, this Christmas tree replicates the beauty of a real tree, which is completed with vivid branch tips and lush mixed foliage. Plus, selected PE and PVC make it resist fire and deformations, while not causing allergies and having no weird smells.
Stability for Versatile Use: Supported by a folding metal stand, the Xmas tree gains perfect stability, while its anti-slip foot pads will keep the floor from being scratched. Whether placed in the office, home or shop, it will add a touch of festive magic to any space.
Ideal Sparkling Illumination: The Xmas tree is adorned with warm white lights, creating an enchanting holiday vibe. Meanwhile, its LED lights present better quality, proven by lower energy consumption, higher safety and a longer lifespan.
Guarantee - 1 year
Artificial christmas tree type: Hooked
Assembly required
With stand

Christmas Baubles
Adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Colour: Pink. Quantity: 100 pack.
Pack of 100 pink Christmas baubles for festive tree decoration.
Decorative detail design adds a stylish focal point to your display.
Made from durable plastic, ideal for repeated seasonal use.
Versatile pink colour coordinates easily with various holiday themes.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof
Included: 100 Christmas baubles

5037204485352.variantName: Christmas Tree Decorations - Festive Hanging Ornaments - Father Christmas Motif - Plastic - for Christmas at Home - Single Item
5037204485352.sourceDescription:
Christmas Tree Decorations
These Christmas tree decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive Father Christmas motif adds a recognisable seasonal character to your display.
Single item design allows flexible placement as a focal point within any arrangement.
Durable plastic construction ensures longevity for repeated holiday use and storage.
Versatile decorative accessory suitable for enhancing home Christmas displays indoors.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof
Included: 1x Father Christmas decoration
Hanger included

Father Christmas Motif

Create a focal point

Style around the occasion

Give the detail room to show

Group them with candles, greenery and decorations, place them where they can be seen from outside, or use them to create a cosy corner for the family to enjoy throughout December. A simple, stylish way to bring festive sparkle into your home, and a lovely finishing touch for Christmas displays and parties. At a glance: LED infinity light | super bright LEDs | infinity mirror effect | 3m lead cable | BS IP20 transformer | mains powered | indoor use.

MODERN CENTREPIECE : A contemporary festive feature that draws the eye and sparks conversation.
MAINS POWERED : A consistent, bright glow all evening.
3M LEAD CABLE : Supplied with a 3m lead cable and BS IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket to your chosen spot.
INDOOR USE : Lovely in living rooms, hallways, bedrooms and windows.

Costume Wig
Adds an accessory to your chosen outfit or activity. Key details include soft feel and removable design.

Soft Feel
The soft surface gives a comfortable contact feel. Its texture is useful where the item is handled regularly or placed alongside other soft furnishings.

Removable Design
The removable design allows the relevant part to be taken off when needed. It gives more flexibility when arranging, cleaning or storing the product according to its intended use.

Choose your fit
Use the stated measurements or size as the starting point for choosing the product. Consider how it will sit alongside the clothing or footwear already being worn, allowing the finished arrangement to suit your normal movement and routine.

Coordinate with your wardrobe
The listed colour provides a clear way to pair the accessory with existing clothing. It can repeat a familiar tone or introduce a different accent, depending on how you prefer to put together the overall outfit.

Consider the material
The stated material helps you judge how the accessory will fit with the rest of your clothing. Follow the specific care and use information for this product, as fabric appearance alone does not establish washing, temperature or protective performance.

Use around your routine
Choose the wearing arrangement that suits the activity for which the accessory is intended. Where the design offers adjustment, set it before use and check the fit again if the surrounding clothing or the way it is worn changes.

Orderly storage
Store the accessory in a way that supports its shape and keeps it accessible with related belongings. A consistent storage position makes it easier to include it in your usual preparation routine and to keep track of smaller pieces.

Product details
Colour: Purple. Dimensions: 66 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Soft finish provides a comfortable feel for regular handling.
Removable design allows easy cleaning and flexible storage.
Purple colour coordinates easily with existing costumes.
Single item pack ideal for parties and fancy dress.

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and polyester construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Handmade Detail
Handmade detailing contributes to the character of the design. The decorative elements give the product a distinct appearance that can be coordinated with the surrounding arrangement.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Polyester. Colour: Red. Product measurements: length 5.5 cm, width 8.5 cm, height 17 cm. Product weight: 0.02 kg. Quantity: 2 pack.

5096042276652.baseName: Mini Christmas wreaths - Small hanging wreaths - Six mini wreaths with ribbon bows for close-up festive displays - Beige, 15 cm
5096042276652.variantName: Mini Christmas wreaths - Small hanging wreaths - Six mini wreaths with ribbon bows for close-up festive displays - Beige, 15 cm
5096042276652.sourceDescription:
The wreaths measure about 15 cm across, while the hanging arrangement has an overall length of about 50 cm. Beige ribbon bows soften the look, making the set of six particularly suited to a row of kitchen cupboards.

The small scale allows a wreath to be part of the room rather than its main decoration. A door with a narrow panel or a corner beside a window can take a seasonal detail without losing the space you need for handles and everyday fittings.

To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree. Even a single matching accent can bring two separate displays together. A narrow ribbon in a colour taken from the design makes a discreet finishing touch if you use your own hanger. Varying the length of the ribbon lets you line up the centre of the wreath with a panel or a nearby mirror.

After the festive season, lay the decoration in a box with space around its edges. Keep heavy ornaments and tightly coiled strings of lights separate so that the front of the wreath keeps its shape in storage. If you already have a busy Christmas tree, give the wreath a space of its own. A quiet patch of wall brings the outline into focus and gives visitors a chance to see the individual details as they pass.

For a cupboard door, measure the hanging drop as well as the width of the wreath. Position the decoration high enough to leave the handle free and check that it sits flat when the cupboard is opened and closed. When decorating a narrow window, check the view from the other side before deciding on the exact height.

At the end of the season, wrap the small decoration loosely and leave space around any raised details. Keeping ribbon laid flat also helps it sit neatly the next time you hang the wreath.
Set of six mini wreaths, each measuring 15 cm across, ideal for close-up festive displays on kitchen cupboards or narrow window panels.
Features elegant beige ribbon bows that soften the aesthetic, allowing the small scale to integrate seamlessly into room decor without dominating the space.
Designed for versatile placement, these hanging decorations fit perfectly beside mirrors or on cupboard doors, leaving handles and everyday fittings unobstructed.
Easy to store after the season; simply lay flat in a box with space around edges to maintain shape and protect raised details from damage.

5096042277352.sourceDescription:
The silver-coloured 29.5 cm hanger sits above a ring of 110 green branches. A 50 cm diameter gives you room for a few of your own ornaments while keeping the shape of the foliage visible around them.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. Consider the drop of the hanger as well as the size of the wreath when choosing a door. Hold the two together before positioning them, so the arrangement sits comfortably between the upper panel and the handle.

Fine pine-style sprigs lend themselves to a simple woodland scheme. A plain background keeps the outline of the needles visible, especially where the foliage spreads towards the edge of the decoration. The centre opening lets the background play a part in the design. Pale paint gives the foliage a sharp outline, while a darker panel draws attention to the texture at the tips of the branches.

When you unpack the greenery, support the wreath from behind and ease any compressed outer sprigs apart gently. Turn the wreath as you work so that you can check the outline from the front as well as from the side. For a simpler finish, keep additional decorations to one part of the ring and let the natural shape of the foliage show elsewhere.

A simple way to plan the setting is to mark the centre of the intended space with a small piece of paper. Hold the decoration over it, then step back to see how it sits alongside the door surround or other wall decorations. A plain background lets you see the smaller details even from the other side of the room. Try holding the wreath against a light wall and then against a darker door before fixing the hanging point.
Comes with a silver hanger and 110 pine-style branches for immediate festive display.
Features a 50 cm diameter ring, providing ample space for personal ornaments.
Includes a 29.5 cm door hanger, designed to sit comfortably above the wreath.
Compact design suitable for hallways, mantels, or doors without overwhelming the space.
Comes with 2 storage organisers
Hanging rope included

Christmas Decoration
It adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product Description

 This winter magic beaded christmas tree kit is a fun handmade craft set, all parts are prepared for you to assemble a delicate mini christmas tree.

Specifications

 Style: Winter Magic DIY Beaded Christmas Tree Kit, Package: Boxed, Light: Battery operated LED string lights

Package Includes

Craft activity and display piece: Designed for adults, craft enthusiasts, friends, and family members who enjoy hands-on seasonal projects. The recipient can enjoy the building process first, then use the completed beaded tree as part of their holiday decoration year after year
Compact tabletop decoration: Display the completed tree on a mantel, coffee table, office desk, bookshelf, entryway console, dining table, or bedroom dresser. Its compact format adds christmas character to smaller spaces without requiring room for a full-size tree

5093251033052.baseName: Christmas Inflatable - LED Light Display - Quick Inflation Setup - 285cm Height Size - Family Gift Idea - 1 Chair Equivalent Count
5093251033052.variantName: Christmas Inflatable - LED Light Display - Quick Inflation Setup - 285cm Height Size - Family Gift Idea - 1 Chair Equivalent Count
5093251033052.sourceDescription:
This giant Christmas inflatable features a charming Santa Claus sitting with a reindeer and gift box. Measuring 285cm tall, it creates a delightful festive atmosphere as a hanging decoration. The design serves as a cheerful focal point that delights the neighbourhood during the holiday season.

Bright LED light effects illuminate your holiday area with a festive glow. Four light modules contain twelve LED beads located in Santa's head, reindeer's neck, inside the gift box and waist. This ensures high night visibility to make your garden shine throughout the evening.

Fast setup is achieved via an integrated 16.8W blower and bottom zipper for inflation in about one minute. Engineered with safe 12V low voltage and a standard UK BS plug, this decoration provides peace of mind operation. A 1.9m power cord offers flexible placement options.

Introducing the 60cm Inflatable Mirror Display Ball in Red, a striking and versatile decorative solution designed to create instant impact in retail environments, commercial venues, events, exhibitions, and the home.

Available across the full range of sizes and colours, it offers exceptional flexibility for both standalone use and grouped displays.

A key advantage for commercial users is ease of storage. Once deflated — or with the air removed using a compatible electric pump — the display ball folds down to a fraction of its inflated size, making off-season storage simple and space-efficient.

Manufactured from fire-retardant materials, the Inflatable Mirror Display Ball is suitable for use in commercial and public spaces. It is inflated once, sealed securely, and displayed without the need for a continuous power supply.
